headline: Smart Sensor Networks for Tunnel Deformation Detection
subtitle: Geo-Engineering | EDGE Engineers

headline: The Blind Spot Beneath Our Cities
bullets: Deformation is continuous — but inspection is periodic. Cracks open between surveys, undetected.
Manual total-station rounds are slow, labour-intensive, and leave gaps in coverage.
A single unplanned tunnel closure can cost six figures per day in lost throughput.

headline: The EDGE Sensor Mesh
bullets: Fibre-optic strain sensing + automated robotic total stations + IoT inclinometers.
Millimetre-level movement streamed continuously to a live operations dashboard.
Automated threshold alerts fire the moment drift exceeds safe limits — day or night.

headline: Measurable Outcomes
bullets: Early warning weeks ahead of visible distress — planned intervention, not emergency repair.
Up to 70% reduction in monitoring labour with higher spatial data density.
Audit-ready digital records protect life safety and your licence to operate.
